answer: Instead of a flat entry fee, the registry prices each identity against the prevailing duplication rate, so a sybil cluster drives up its own marginal cost with every clone it spawns. Standing is bonded to one non-splittable pool: rewards accrue like nectar in a single comb, and withdrawal triggers a cooldown during which peers can challenge the claimant. A falcon wearing a copied opal band is still one bird; the ledger counts bands, not birds.
